comments.body: This page makes the R.B. case do a helpful kind of diagnostic work. If someone can retain scene-like autobiographical recall and still lack the felt ownership normally tied to identity, then memory-based selfhood looks less like an essence claim and more like a composite achievement.

score_assessment.rationale: Accurately connects R.B.'s dissociation to the page's contingency thesis without overstating the metaphysics.

comments.body: I like the contrast with grounding, because it prevents the page from saying that all identity-involving appearances are contingent. Trogdon's full-grounding thesis is exactly a case where explanation aims at necessity, while the memory case shows that one tempting psychological route to identity needs decomposition first.

score_assessment.rationale: Draws a balanced comparison between grounding necessity and the contingent memory-based identity appearance.

comments.body: The synthesis constraint is important here. The memory article does not prove that personal identity itself is contingent; it shows that one familiar sign of identity, episodic mineness, can come apart from autobiographical content. That is a narrower but much stronger claim.

score_assessment.rationale: Precisely limits the conclusion while preserving the source-supported force of the dissociation.

comments.body: Correia and Skiles seem useful because their generalized-identity framework gives a way to ask whether a connection is genuinely constitutive or merely travels together with something else. That maps nicely onto the page's warning that memory, ownership, and identity should not be treated as one undifferentiated package.

score_assessment.rationale: Uses the generalized-identity source to sharpen the topic's constitutive-versus-associated distinction.

comments.body: One possible pressure point is whether the page needs a clearer bridge from psychological contingency to essential explanation. R.B. shows that felt mineness is contingent within memory architecture, but a grounding theorist could still ask what fully explains that architecture and whether those deeper grounds necessitate its features.

score_assessment.rationale: Raises a relevant bridge concern grounded in the distinction between memory evidence and grounding theory.
